comment.narrative: a Onboarding for volunteers willing to become rescuers provides offers theoretical knowledge to volunteers including rescuers in voluntary civil defence units and the general public. The course focuses on safety regulations and administering first aid to prevent and mitigate emergency situations. The total number of trainees that took the course 5094 and 3492were awarded certificates.The feedback Thank you for summarizing the appropriate actions in emergency situations which are extremely important for saving and preserving the lives of our citizens especially during wartime. Additionally its great that the information is provided online allowing you to enhance your knowledge and skills at any convenient time and access it for repeated study b The online course Watch Your Step Watch Where Youre Going focuses on landmine safety for adults and children. Out of 554440 trainees 503107 received certificates. The feedback Thank you for providing this course and the opportunity to participate in it. Its highly relevant and absolutely necessary particularly in deoccupied territories like ours. Sadly there have been casualties among children due to landmines left by the occupiers. c The online course Volunteering from A to Z on the management of volunteering activities had 2103 registered individuals. It covers practical insights on various aspects of volunteering including legal frameworks recruitment training teambuilding motivation project involvement and organizational accountability.The feedback I listened to the course with great pleasure and learned a lot of new information. It was meaningful and interesting. Thank you d The fourth course United Ukraine Rise of a National Identity was launched in November 2023. Course United Ukraine Rise of a National Identity aimed to foster the Ukrainian identity among the population raise awareness about the history of struggle for Ukraines independence and volunteer movement and deepen knowledge of Ukraines recent history and its European choice. The total number of trainees that took the course 20021 individuals are registered among whom 3492.The feedbackAn interesting series of lectures with materials presented in an accessible manner worth exploring for all Ukrainians. Feedback Source Zrozumilo online education platform MEL Database 20222024.
